title: Speed and Reynolds number
hook: Change flow speed and predict Reynolds number.
misconception: Reynolds number stays fixed when flow speed doubles.
objective: Apply Re = ρvL/η to compare Reynolds number when flow speed changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With fixed fluid density viscosity and characteristic length, Re = ρvL/η. When flow speed doubles, Reynolds number becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Re = ρvL/η; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider fixed fluid density viscosity and characteristic length, with a nonzero initial result. If flow speed triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on Reynolds number?
recall.why: Apply Re = ρvL/η under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
